text: You are not lazy, my friend. You are exhausted on the inside. And you have been this way so long that you think it is normal. You wake up tired. You spend the day tired. You go to bed tired.

And it does not matter how long you sleep. The next day is the same. You think it is your age. You think it is work. It is neither. Think about how you live. You wake already thinking of everything you have to do. You take care of everyone except yourself.

You swallow what you feel, because there is no time to feel it. You smile even while you are falling apart. Your body absorbs all of it. The anger you never express. The sadness you never release. And it turns all of that into exhaustion.
What you need is not more sleep. What you need is to put down what you have been carrying for years. Everything I know is inside The Quiet Between Thoughts. The link is in my profile.
